scripts.build: npm install; node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public/js/vendor', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js', 'public/js/vendor/jquery.min.js'); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/jquery-ui/dist/jquery-ui.min.js', 'public/js/vendor/jquery-ui.min.js'); console.log('Build complete: jQuery and jQuery UI copied to public/js/vendor/');"
